feedback: For the crop sort, confirm wheat, rice and maize as wind-pollinated and apples, almonds, oilseed rape, strawberries as insect-pollinated (noting oilseed rape chiefly benefits from, rather than wholly depends on, insect pollination).
On the mitigation item, require the justification to name which decline cause the chosen mitigation addresses.
activities.intendedInsight: Pupils can retrieve the crop categories and cause→mitigation links and justify a solution choice.
learnerActions: Sort a set of crops into insect-pollinated vs wind-pollinated.
Answer a question on the likely consequences of pollinator decline for food supply.
Match each decline cause (habitat loss, pesticides, disease) to a plausible mitigation.
Choose a 'best mitigation' for a given scenario and write a one-sentence justification linking it to the cause.
activities.title: Sort crops and justify a mitigation
